headline: Bank of Japan Net Income Contracts on Higher Interest Payments for Reserves
summary: The Bank of Japan reported a drop in first-half net income to 1.55 trillion yen as rising interest rates increased payments made on excess reserves parked with the central bank.
why: Central bank profitability is affected by rising policy rates, which increase the cost of servicing commercial bank reserves held at the institution.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Higher interest payments on excess reserves impact central bank financial accounts.
